API ReferenceZIdentity APIGroupsGroups Ops Update
Groups Ops Update
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/groups/:id

Update an existing group based on the provided group ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the group to be updated.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
name
string
REQUIRED

The name of the group.

Possible values: <= 128 characters

description
string

A description of the group.

Possible values: <= 256 characters

Responses
​
200
500

The request has succeeded, and the group details have been updated.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
name
string
REQUIRED

The name of the group.

Possible values: <= 128 characters

description
string

A description of the group.

Possible values: <= 256 characters

id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier for the group.

source
SourceType (string)
REQUIRED

The source type of the group.

Possible values: [UI, API, SCIM, JIT]

idp
object
REQUIRED
isDynamicGroup
boolean
REQUIRED

Boolean flag indicating if the group is dynamic.

adminEntitlementEnabled
boolean
REQUIRED

Whether the group supports admin entitlements.

serviceEntitlementEnabled
boolean
REQUIRED

Whether the group supports service entitlements.
